Original target, executed reconstruction and every individual cell.

Only the reference decoder colours are used in the pixel image. Flat digital fills replace the photograph's marker texture; no cell shape or colour category is changed.

Sixteen programs · code analysis only

Map: A D E K / F C L G / H B J O / I M N P. Standard zones are 4 × 4 cells; the original last row and column of zones are smaller, so no source cells are added or removed. Programs use only a numeric input and deterministic variable operations; there are no theory questions, sprite movements, colour sensors or random answers.

Adapted from the code-tracing patterns in Y3_Variable4.pdf pp. 2–3 and Y3_Variables2.pdf pp. 1–3: set versus change, ordered changes, repeated changes and branching. Additional combinations are adaptations, not verbatim copies. The overlapping Y3_Variables7.pdf, theory-heavy Y3_Variables6.pdf, movement-heavy Y3_Variables5.pdf and student-results report Variables_3D.pdf were screened but not copied into the activity. No names or student results are included.

Source and extraction evidence

Supplied original reference image. The supplied completed grid determines every target cell. No hidden-image cells are invented.

Extraction: sample coloured interior pixels separately in each cell; reject borders and much of the printed ink; select the majority colour. The vote proportion is a sampling diagnostic, not a statistical probability of correctness. The map was also visually checked against the supplied grid.
